validation.title: Synthetic detection-quality regression
validation.methodology: benchmarks/benchmark.py runs 100 deterministic seeds for each of five declared scenarios.
validation.groundTruth: Scenario labels declared in the benchmark fixture.
validation.metricPolicy: Classification metrics, latency percentiles and bootstrap uncertainty are produced by core/evaluation.py.
validation.resultBoundary: Regression gate requires all seeded malicious scenarios to remain detectable and the declared benign scenario to remain free of false positives.
validation.limitations: Synthetic regression is not real-world, customer-scale, independent or production validation.
validation.reproducibility: Run python benchmarks/benchmark.py from the repository root with the documented dependencies.

validation.title: External labeled-traffic validation
validation.methodology: Frozen protocol requiring provenance-controlled labeled external traffic, leakage controls and independent evaluation.
validation.limitations: Real-world labeled-corpus and independent evaluation remain outstanding.
validation.reproducibility: Protocol and data contract are documented; execution requires the external corpus/evaluator.
